desc: Implement cycle detection (indegree pruning), forest construction for non-cycle nodes, and bottom-up tree DP g_v(c) with prefix sums in O(NM).
Combine cycle nodes per component via pointwise product over c, sum over c=1..M mod 998244353, multiply component totals; handle self-loops, multiple cycles, N=1, M=1.
Run the code on Samples 1, 2, 3 — PASSED all three (6, 2025, 10010).
Confirm O(NM) complexity acceptable for N,M ≤ 2025 and that no stored P array is mutated in place (aliasing safety).
